ex.en: Coding is now part of the school curriculum.
ex.zh: 程式設計現在已納入學校課程。

ex.en: The new curriculum focuses on critical thinking.
ex.zh: 新課綱著重批判性思考。

curriculum.en: all the subjects taught in a school or course

ex.en: The cumulative effect of stress can harm your health.
ex.zh: 壓力的累積效應會傷害健康。

ex.en: Cumulative sales reached one million units.
ex.zh: 累計銷售量達到一百萬台。

cumulative.en: growing bigger as more is added over time

ex.en: India is a region rich in culinary culture.
ex.zh: 印度是一個飲食文化豐富的地區。

ex.en: She studied at a culinary school in Paris.
ex.zh: 她在巴黎的廚藝學校念書。

ex.en: Taipei is famous for its culinary scene.
ex.zh: 台北以美食聞名。

ex.en: You can customize the settings to suit your needs.
ex.zh: 你可以依需求自訂設定。

ex.en: We customize our products for each client.
ex.zh: 我們為每位客戶量身打造產品。

ex.en: The software lets users customize their dashboards.
ex.zh: 這個軟體讓使用者可以自訂儀表板。

customize.en: to change something to fit what a person wants

ex.en: She put a cushion on the chair.
ex.zh: 她在椅子上放了個坐墊。

ex.en: The sofa has four soft cushions.
ex.zh: 沙發上有四個軟軟的靠墊。

cushion.en: a soft bag that you sit on or lean against

ex.en: Savings can cushion you against a sudden job loss.
ex.zh: 存款能在突然失業時提供緩衝。

ex.en: The airbag cushioned the impact.
ex.zh: 安全氣囊減輕了撞擊力道。

cushion.en: to make the bad effect of something less painful

ex.en: The government is trying to curb inflation.
ex.zh: 政府正試圖抑制通膨。

ex.en: We need to curb spending this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季我們得控制支出。

curb.en: to control something to stop it from growing

ex.en: Please park close to the curb.
ex.zh: 請把車停靠近路邊。

ex.en: The taxi pulled up to the curb.
ex.zh: 計程車停到路邊。

curb.en: the edge of a path where it meets the road

ex.en: The doctor cured him of his cancer.
ex.zh: 醫生治好了他的癌症。

ex.en: This medicine cured me of my cold.
ex.zh: 這藥治好了我的感冒。

ex.en: There aren't any medicines that can cure this disease.
ex.zh: 沒有任何藥物能治好這種病。

cure.en: to make a sick person healthy again

ex.en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
ex.zh: 預防勝於治療。

ex.en: There is still no cure for the common cold.
ex.zh: 一般感冒至今仍沒有根治的方法。

cure.en: a medicine or treatment that makes an illness go away, or a solution to a problem

ex.en: The hair dresser is cutting the hair with scissors.
ex.zh: 理髮師正在用剪刀剪頭髮。

ex.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 把蛋糕切成大小相等的塊相當困難。

ex.en: I cut my finger while cooking.
ex.zh: 我煮飯時切到手指。

cut.en: to use a knife or scissors to divide or remove part of something

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你菸抽太多了，應該少抽一點。

ex.en: The company plans to cut costs next year.
ex.zh: 公司計畫明年削減成本。

cut.en: to make something smaller in amount

ex.en: Staff are worried about pay cuts.
ex.zh: 員工擔心被減薪。

ex.en: The tax cut will help small businesses.
ex.zh: 減稅對小型企業有幫助。

cut.en: a reduction in the size or amount of something

ex.en: How did you get that cut on your hand?
ex.zh: 你手上那道傷口是怎麼來的？

ex.en: It's just a small cut. It'll heal soon.
ex.zh: 只是小傷口，很快就會好。

cut.en: an injury where the skin has been opened by something sharp

ex.en: He is a person who never cuts corners.
ex.zh: 他是個從不偷工減料的人。

ex.en: Don't cut corners on safety.
ex.zh: 安全方面不能偷工減料。

cut.en: to do something in a cheaper or quicker way, giving up quality

ex.en: There are many countries and many cultures on Earth.
ex.zh: 地球上有很多國家和文化。

ex.en: It's good for our understanding of other cultures.
ex.zh: 這有助於我們了解其他文化。

ex.en: Despite different languages and cultures, everyone still became friends.
ex.zh: 儘管語言和文化不同，大家還是成了朋友。

culture.en: the ideas, customs and way of life of a group of people

ex.en: Our company has a very open culture.
ex.zh: 我們公司的文化很開放。

ex.en: Work culture in Japan can be very strict.
ex.zh: 日本的職場文化可能非常嚴格。

culture.en: the shared attitudes and ways of behaving in a company or group

ex.en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.
ex.zh: 文章一開頭先說明目前的情勢。

ex.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.
ex.zh: 他在課堂上舉辦了一場時事辯論。

ex.en: Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
ex.zh: 我們目前的危機不只是經濟危機。

ex.en: We rowed up the river against the current.
ex.zh: 我們逆流划船而上。

ex.en: Let's try and swim against the current.
ex.zh: 我們試著逆流游泳吧。

current.en: the movement of water, air or electricity in one direction

ex.en: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.
ex.zh: 倫敦過去因為經濟和文化因素而十分重要。

ex.en: Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
ex.zh: 文化交流計畫能加強鄰國之間的友好關係。

ex.en: There are many cultural differences between Taiwan and Japan.
ex.zh: 台灣和日本之間有許多文化差異。

cultural.en: relating to the customs, arts and ideas of a society

ex.en: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 他和他的姊妹目前住在東京。

ex.en: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is currently unavailable.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，您撥的電話目前無法接通。

ex.en: Currently Burj Khalifa is the tallest skyscraper in the world.
ex.zh: 目前哈里發塔是世界上最高的摩天大樓。

ex.en: I always have two cups of coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上總是喝兩杯咖啡。

ex.en: How many cups of coffee do you drink a day?
ex.zh: 你一天喝幾杯咖啡？

ex.en: I would like to have another cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 我想再來一杯咖啡。

cup.en: a small round container for drinking, or the amount it holds

ex.en: Our team won the cup last year.
ex.zh: 我們隊去年贏得了獎盃。

ex.en: Who do you think will win the World Cup?
ex.zh: 你覺得誰會贏得世界盃？

cup.en: a metal prize given to a winner, or a sports contest where it is won

ex.en: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路有急彎。

ex.en: The sales curve went up sharply in May.
ex.zh: 銷售曲線在五月大幅上揚。

curve.en: a line or road that bends smoothly

ex.en: The road curves along the coast.
ex.zh: 這條路沿著海岸蜿蜒。

ex.en: The path curves to the left near the lake.
ex.zh: 小路在湖邊向左彎。

curve.en: to bend in a smooth round shape

curve.zh: learning curve：學習曲線（上手所需的過程）

ex.en: There's a steep learning curve with this software.
ex.zh: 這套軟體需要花不少時間才能上手。

ex.en: The new job has a learning curve, but I'm enjoying it.
ex.zh: 新工作需要時間上手，但我做得很開心。

curve.en: the time and effort needed to learn a new skill

ex.en: She is curious to find who sent the flowers.
ex.zh: 她很想知道是誰送來了那束花。

ex.en: She was so curious that she opened the box.
ex.zh: 她太好奇了，所以打開了盒子。

ex.en: Tom said that he was curious.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他很好奇。

curious.en: wanting to know or learn about something

ex.en: It was curious that Tom didn't do that.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有那樣做，這有點奇怪。

ex.en: There was a curious smell in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有一股奇怪的味道。

ex.en: The room looks different after I've changed the curtains.
ex.zh: 我換了窗簾以後，房間看起來不一樣了。

ex.en: When I opened the curtains, it was snowing.
ex.zh: 我拉開窗簾時，外面正在下雪。

ex.en: She hung a curtain over the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗戶上掛了窗簾。

curtain.en: a piece of cloth that hangs to cover a window

ex.en: The curtain rose and the show began.
ex.zh: 布幕升起，表演開始了。

ex.en: The actors came out for a curtain call.
ex.zh: 演員們出來謝幕。

curtain.en: a large cloth in a theater that opens and closes in front of the stage

ex.en: That's my cue to leave.
ex.zh: 這就是我該走的信號了。

ex.en: The actor missed his cue.
ex.zh: 那位演員錯過了上場提示。

cue.en: a signal that tells someone when to do something

cue.zh: on cue：恰好在這時、正如預期

ex.en: As if on cue, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 電話彷彿算好時機似的響了。

ex.en: Right on cue, the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 公車剛好在這時抵達。

ex.en: In Asian culture it's customary to take one's shoes off before entering a house or temple.
ex.zh: 在亞洲文化裡，進入住家或寺廟前習慣先脫鞋。

ex.en: It is customary to exchange business cards at the first meeting.
ex.zh: 初次見面時交換名片是慣例。

customary.en: usual and done by most people in a place

ex.en: Budget cutbacks forced us to delay the project.
ex.zh: 預算刪減迫使我們延後這個專案。

ex.en: The company announced cutbacks in staff.
ex.zh: 公司宣布裁減人力。

cutback.en: a reduction in the amount of money or workers

ex.en: The tiger cub looked like a large kitten.
ex.zh: 那隻小老虎看起來像一隻大貓。

ex.en: The bear cub stayed close to its mother.
ex.zh: 小熊緊緊跟在媽媽身邊。

cub.en: a young lion, tiger, bear or wolf

cub.zh: 新手的、資淺的（如 cub reporter）

ex.en: She started as a cub reporter at a local paper.
ex.zh: 她在地方報社從菜鳥記者做起。

ex.en: The cub reporter got his first big story.
ex.zh: 那名菜鳥記者拿到了他第一個大新聞。

ex.en: After the divorce, she got custody of the children.
ex.zh: 離婚後，她取得了孩子的監護權。

ex.en: They share custody of their son.
ex.zh: 他們共同擁有兒子的監護權。

custody.en: the legal right to take care of a child

ex.en: The man was held in police custody.
ex.zh: 那名男子被警方拘留了。

ex.en: The police held him in custody.
ex.zh: 警方拘留了他。

custody.en: the state of being kept by the police

ex.en: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 她把毛巾摺好收進櫃子裡。

ex.en: Open the cupboard to the left, the bottles are in there.
ex.zh: 打開左邊的櫥櫃，瓶子在裡面。

ex.en: Tom opened the shoe cupboard and took the shoes out.
ex.zh: 湯姆打開鞋櫃，把鞋子拿出來。

cupboard.en: a piece of furniture with doors where things are kept

ex.en: This is the cutest puppy I've ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最可愛的小狗。

ex.en: What do you think is cuter than a cat?
ex.zh: 你認為什麼東西比貓咪更可愛？

ex.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.
ex.zh: 在麵包房工作的姑娘很可愛。

cute.en: attractive in a sweet and charming way

ex.en: People say that the fox is more cunning than other animals.
ex.zh: 人們說，狐狸比其他動物要狡猾。

ex.en: The cunning thief fooled the guards with a fake uniform.
ex.zh: 狡猾的小偷穿著假制服騙過了警衛。

cunning.en: clever in a way that tricks people

ex.en: Please send your curriculum vitae to the HR department.
ex.zh: 請將你的履歷寄給人事部。

ex.en: Her curriculum vitae lists ten years of teaching experience.
ex.zh: 她的履歷上列有十年的教學經驗。

curriculum vitae.en: a short written record of your education and work experience

ex.en: Today's Beijing has given me a very deep impression and aroused my curiosity.
ex.zh: 現在的北京讓我印象深刻，也激起了我的好奇心。

ex.en: Curiosity killed the cat.
ex.zh: 好奇心會害死貓。

curiosity.en: a strong wish to know or learn about something

ex.en: The family worried that their son had joined a dangerous cult.
ex.zh: 家人擔心兒子加入了一個危險的邪教。

ex.en: The cult leader controlled every part of his followers' lives.
ex.zh: 那個邪教領袖控制著信徒生活的每個層面。

cult.en: a small religious group with strange beliefs that many people fear

ex.en: The old movie has a cult following among college students.
ex.zh: 這部老電影在大學生之間擁有一群死忠影迷。

ex.en: There is a cult of youth in the fashion industry.
ex.zh: 時尚界盛行一種對年輕的狂熱崇拜。

cult.en: great popularity among a small group of fans

ex.en: These customs differ from those in our country.
ex.zh: 這些習俗和我們國家的不一樣。

ex.en: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.
ex.zh: 一個國家的禮儀和習俗反映了它的文化。

ex.en: As was the custom in those days, he married young.
ex.zh: 照當時的習俗，他很年輕就結婚了。

custom.en: a way of behaving that is traditional in a society

ex.en: It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我習慣在早餐前出去散步。

ex.en: It was his custom to read before bed.
ex.zh: 他習慣睡前閱讀。

custom.en: something that a person does regularly

ex.en: She ordered a custom wedding dress.
ex.zh: 她訂製了一件婚紗。

ex.en: The app lets you create custom themes.
ex.zh: 這個 App 讓你自訂主題。

ex.en: What is the currency of Taiwan?
ex.zh: 台灣的貨幣是什麼？

ex.en: The exchange rates for foreign currency change daily.
ex.zh: 外幣的匯率天天都變。

ex.en: What currency do you use in England?
ex.zh: 在英國用什麼貨幣？

currency.en: the money used in a particular country

ex.en: I experienced culture shock when I first moved to London.
ex.zh: 我剛搬到倫敦時經歷了文化衝擊。

ex.en: Culture shock usually fades after a few months.
ex.zh: 文化衝擊通常幾個月後就會減輕。

culture shock.en: the confused feeling of being in a place with a very different way of life

ex.en: Customs clearance usually takes two days.
ex.zh: 清關通常需要兩天。

ex.en: The shipment is waiting for customs clearance.
ex.zh: 這批貨正在等待清關。

customs clearance.en: official permission for goods to pass through the border checks of a country

cuisine.zh: 料理、菜餚（某地的烹調風格）

ex.en: Do you like Chinese cuisine?
ex.zh: 你喜歡中式料理嗎？

ex.en: This restaurant serves French cuisine, but with Japanese tableware.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應法式料理，但用的是日式餐具。

ex.en: Rice and noodles are commonplace in Chinese cuisine.
ex.zh: 米飯和麵條在中式料理中很常見。

cuisine.en: a style of cooking from a particular place

ex.en: We have a parking lot for the customers.
ex.zh: 我們有顧客專用的停車場。

ex.en: We have more customers than we can count.
ex.zh: 我們的顧客多到數不清。

ex.en: We're looking for someone who has experience in customer service.
ex.zh: 我們在找有客服經驗的人。

customer.en: a person who buys things from a shop or company

ex.en: The lab works at the cutting edge of robotics.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室從事最前沿的機器人研究。

ex.en: Our team develops products at the cutting edge of battery technology.
ex.zh: 我們的團隊開發最前沿的電池技術產品。

cutting edge.en: the newest and most advanced stage of development

ex.en: The restaurant provides reusable cutlery with every takeaway meal.
ex.zh: 這間餐廳每份外帶餐點都附可重複使用的刀叉餐具。

ex.en: Place the cutlery beside the folded napkin.
ex.zh: 請把刀叉餐具放在摺好的餐巾旁。

cutlery.en: knives, forks and spoons used for eating

ex.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被海關人員搜身。

ex.en: The package was confiscated by customs.
ex.zh: 包裹被海關扣押了。

customs.en: the place at a border where officials check goods coming into a country

ex.en: Social customs vary from country to country.
ex.zh: 各國的社會習俗都不一樣。

ex.en: These old customs have been handed down from generation to generation.
ex.zh: 這些古老習俗都是一代一代相傳下來的。

customs.en: traditional ways of behaving in a society

ex.en: My cubicle is next to the window.
ex.zh: 我的隔間座位在窗戶旁邊。

ex.en: He decorated his cubicle with family photos.
ex.zh: 他用全家福照片裝飾他的隔間。

cubicle.en: a small area in a large room separated by low walls

ex.en: She kept a newspaper cutting about the festival.
ex.zh: 她留著一份有關這個慶典的剪報。

ex.en: He planted a cutting from his mother's rose bush.
ex.zh: 他種下一根從母親玫瑰叢剪下的枝條。

ex.en: He loves listening to Cuban music.
ex.zh: 他喜歡聽古巴音樂。

ex.en: We tried a Cuban sandwich at a small cafe.
ex.zh: 我們在一家小咖啡館吃了古巴三明治。

ex.en: The Cuban at the next table was telling stories about Havana.
ex.zh: 隔壁桌的古巴人正在講哈瓦那的故事。

ex.en: Many Cubans enjoy baseball.
ex.zh: 許多古巴人喜歡棒球。

ex.en: She had a soft curl of hair on her forehead.
ex.zh: 她額頭上有一綹柔軟的捲髮。

ex.en: A curl of smoke rose from the chimney.
ex.zh: 一縷捲曲的煙從煙囪裡升起。

ex.en: She curls her hair every morning before school.
ex.zh: 她每天早上上學前都會把頭髮捲一捲。

ex.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 貓蜷縮在沙發上睡著了。

ex.en: The paper began to curl in the heat.
ex.zh: 紙張在高溫下開始捲了起來。

ex.en: Farmers here cultivate rice on the flat land near the river.
ex.zh: 這裡的農夫在靠河的平地上種稻。

ex.en: It takes time to cultivate good study habits.
ex.zh: 養成良好的讀書習慣需要時間。

ex.en: She tries to cultivate friendships with people from different countries.
ex.zh: 她努力和來自不同國家的人培養友誼。

ex.en: A dice is shaped like a cube.
ex.zh: 骰子的形狀是立方體。

ex.en: She dropped two ice cubes into the glass.
ex.zh: 她把兩塊冰塊丟進杯子裡。

ex.en: The cube of 3 is 27.
ex.zh: 3 的立方是 27。

ex.en: In the legend, a curse fell on the village.
ex.zh: 傳說中，這座村莊被下了詛咒。

ex.en: He muttered a curse when he dropped his phone.
ex.zh: 他手機掉到地上時，低聲咒罵了一句。

ex.en: The old woman cursed the thief who stole her bag.
ex.zh: 老婦人咒罵那個偷了她包包的小偷。

ex.en: He cursed under his breath when the train left without him.
ex.zh: 火車沒等他就開走時，他低聲咒罵了一聲。

ex.en: The city is culturally rich, with many museums and festivals.
ex.zh: 這座城市在文化上很豐富，有許多博物館和節慶。

ex.en: It is culturally normal to take off your shoes at the door in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 在台灣，進門脫鞋在文化上是很正常的事。

ex.en: The curator explained the history of each painting to visitors.
ex.zh: 策展人向參觀者解說每幅畫的歷史。

ex.en: She works as a curator at a small art museum.
ex.zh: 她在一間小型美術館擔任策展人。

ex.en: The little girl looked curiously at the strange box.
ex.zh: 小女孩好奇地看著那個奇怪的盒子。

ex.en: He curiously opened the door and peeked inside.
ex.zh: 他好奇地打開門往裡面偷看。

ex.en: The cat curiously sniffed the new toy.
ex.zh: 貓好奇地聞了聞新玩具。

ex.en: Curiously, nobody noticed the mistake for a week.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，整整一週都沒有人發現這個錯誤。

ex.en: Curiously enough, the shop was empty on a Saturday.
ex.zh: 奇怪的是，星期六那間店竟然沒有半個人。

ex.en: The road follows a curved path along the coast.
ex.zh: 這條路沿著海岸蜿蜒彎曲。

ex.en: She bought a curved mirror for the hallway.
ex.zh: 她為走廊買了一面弧形鏡子。

curved.zh: 彎曲（curve 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The river curved around the small village.
ex.zh: 河流繞著那個小村莊彎曲流過。

ex.en: A smile curved on her lips when she saw him.
ex.zh: 她看到他時，嘴角彎起了一抹微笑。

ex.en: The festival will culminate in a big fireworks show.
ex.zh: 這場慶典將以盛大的煙火秀劃下高潮。

ex.en: Years of hard work culminated in her winning the prize.
ex.zh: 多年的努力最終以她獲獎作結。

ex.en: The cultivation of rice needs a lot of water.
ex.zh: 稻米的栽種需要大量的水。

ex.en: These hills are used for the cultivation of tea.
ex.zh: 這些山丘被用來種茶。

ex.en: The cultivation of good habits starts in childhood.
ex.zh: 良好習慣的培養從童年開始。

ex.en: Reading is important for the cultivation of the mind.
ex.zh: 閱讀對於心智的涵養很重要。

ex.en: He rolled up the cuffs of his shirt before washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 他洗碗前先把襯衫袖口捲起來。

ex.en: There was a small stain on the cuff of her coat.
ex.zh: 她外套的袖口上有一小塊污漬。

ex.en: Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean.
ex.zh: 古巴是加勒比海的一個島國。

ex.en: Havana is the capital of Cuba.
ex.zh: 哈瓦那是古巴的首都。

ex.en: The tank holds ten cubic meters of water.
ex.zh: 這個水槽可容納十立方公尺的水。

ex.en: A cubic box has six equal sides.
ex.zh: 立方體的盒子有六個相等的面。

ex.en: He used a pizza cutter to slice the pie.
ex.zh: 他用披薩刀切開披薩。

ex.en: A glass cutter is needed to trim the window pane.
ex.zh: 要裁切窗玻璃需要玻璃刀。

ex.en: The cloth cutter measured the fabric carefully.
ex.zh: 裁布師傅仔細測量了布料。

ex.en: A skilled diamond cutter can turn rough stones into jewels.
ex.zh: 技術高超的鑽石切割師能把原石變成珠寶。

ex.en: I put sliced cucumber in my salad.
ex.zh: 我在沙拉裡放了切片的小黃瓜。

ex.en: A cold cucumber sandwich is nice on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天吃冰涼的小黃瓜三明治很舒服。

ex.en: The school had to curtail its after-class programs because of the budget.
ex.zh: 由於預算有限，學校不得不縮減課後活動。

ex.en: Heavy traffic curtailed our trip, so we came home early.
ex.zh: 交通擁擠縮短了我們的行程，所以我們提早回家。

ex.en: The new law will curtail the use of plastic bags.
ex.zh: 新法規將限制塑膠袋的使用。

ex.en: We had chicken curry with rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐吃了雞肉咖哩飯。

ex.en: This curry is too spicy for the children.
ex.zh: 這道咖哩對孩子們來說太辣了。

ex.en: He tried to curry favor with the boss by working late.
ex.zh: 他想靠加班來討好老闆。

ex.en: She never curries favor with anyone.
ex.zh: 她從不討好任何人。

ex.en: Poor sleep is often the culprit behind constant tiredness.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足往往就是一直覺得累的元兇。

ex.en: After hours of testing, we finally found the culprit causing the error.
ex.zh: 測試了好幾個小時後，我們終於找出造成錯誤的元兇。

ex.en: The police are still searching for the culprit.
ex.zh: 警方仍在搜尋犯人。

ex.en: The culprit left the shop before anyone noticed what he had done.
ex.zh: 嫌犯在沒人發現他的所作所為之前就離開了店裡。

cumbria.zh: 坎布里亞郡（英格蘭西北部）

ex.en: Cumbria is a county in northwest England.
ex.zh: 坎布里亞郡是英格蘭西北部的一個郡。

ex.en: Many hikers visit the lakes and hills of Cumbria.
ex.zh: 許多登山客會前往坎布里亞的湖泊與山丘。

ex.en: We heard a cuckoo singing in the woods this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我們聽到樹林裡有布穀鳥在叫。

ex.en: A cuckoo often lays its eggs in other birds' nests.
ex.zh: 布穀鳥常把蛋下在別種鳥的巢裡。

ex.en: You must be cuckoo if you think I'll jump from there.
ex.zh: 你要是以為我會從那裡跳下去，那你一定是瘋了。

ex.en: My uncle is a little cuckoo, but everyone loves him.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有點瘋瘋癲癲的，但大家都喜歡他。

ex.en: She has long curly hair that she ties up in summer.
ex.zh: 她有一頭長長的捲髮，夏天會把它綁起來。

ex.en: The puppy had a soft, curly coat.
ex.zh: 那隻小狗有柔軟的捲毛。

ex.en: He drew a curly line at the end of the page.
ex.zh: 他在頁尾畫了一條彎彎曲曲的線。

ex.en: The school is planning curricular changes for next year.
ex.zh: 學校正在規劃明年的課程調整。

ex.en: Curricular goals should match the needs of the students.
ex.zh: 課程目標應該符合學生的需求。

ex.en: The city set a curfew after the riot.
ex.zh: 暴動過後，市政府實施了宵禁。

ex.en: My parents gave me a curfew of ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 我爸媽規定我的門禁是十點。

ex.en: The curvature of the Earth can be seen from an airplane.
ex.zh: 從飛機上可以看見地球的曲度。

ex.en: The doctor measured the curvature of his spine.
ex.zh: 醫師測量了他脊椎的彎曲程度。

ex.en: Move the cursor to the word you want to change.
ex.zh: 把游標移到你想修改的字上。

ex.en: The cursor blinked on the empty screen.
ex.zh: 游標在空白的螢幕上閃爍。

ex.en: The old machine is large and cumbersome to move.
ex.zh: 那台舊機器又大又笨重，不好搬動。

ex.en: Filling out the form was a cumbersome process.
ex.zh: 填寫這份表格是個繁瑣的過程。

ex.en: The prize was the culmination of years of hard work.
ex.zh: 這個獎是多年努力的最高成就。

ex.en: The festival's culmination is a huge fireworks show.
ex.zh: 慶典的高潮是一場盛大的煙火秀。

ex.en: Add a spoonful of cumin to give the soup a warm flavor.
ex.zh: 加一匙孜然，讓這道湯帶有溫暖的香氣。

ex.en: Cumin is common in Indian and Mexican cooking.
ex.zh: 孜然常見於印度和墨西哥料理中。

ex.en: He is a cultivated man who loves music and art.
ex.zh: 他是個愛好音樂與藝術、有教養的人。

ex.en: Cultivated land covers most of the valley.
ex.zh: 耕種過的土地覆蓋了山谷大部分地區。

cultured.zh: 有教養的；有文化修養的

ex.en: He is a cultured man who loves music and art.
ex.zh: 他是個熱愛音樂與藝術、有修養的人。

ex.en: She has a cultured voice and a calm manner.
ex.zh: 她的聲音優雅，態度沉穩。

ex.en: The children cuddled up under a warm blanket.
ex.zh: 孩子們蜷縮在暖和的毯子下依偎在一起。

ex.en: She cuddled her baby to sleep.
ex.zh: 她抱著寶寶哄他入睡。

ex.en: The little boy asked for a cuddle from his mom.
ex.zh: 小男孩向媽媽討抱抱。

ex.en: After a long day, a cuddle with the cat feels great.
ex.zh: 忙了一天後，抱著貓咪窩一下感覺真好。

ex.en: She curated an exhibition of young local artists.
ex.zh: 她策劃了一場在地年輕藝術家的展覽。

ex.en: The website curates the best news stories of the week.
ex.zh: 這個網站精選每週最棒的新聞報導。

ex.en: She poured warm custard over the apple pie.
ex.zh: 她把溫熱的卡士達醬淋在蘋果派上。

ex.en: The bakery sells buns filled with sweet custard.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店賣包著甜卡士達內餡的麵包。

cumberland.zh: 坎伯蘭（英格蘭西北部的歷史郡名）

ex.en: Cumberland was a historic county in northwest England.
ex.zh: 坎伯蘭是英格蘭西北部的一個歷史郡。

ex.en: The Lake District partly lies in what was once Cumberland.
ex.zh: 湖區有一部分位於昔日的坎伯蘭境內。

ex.en: The editor culled the best quotes from hundreds of letters.
ex.zh: 編輯從數百封信中挑出了最精彩的引言。

ex.en: Farmers cull weak animals to keep the herd healthy.
ex.zh: 農夫會淘汰體弱的動物，讓整群保持健康。

ex.en: The government announced a cull of the deer population.
ex.zh: 政府宣布要撲殺一部分鹿群。

ex.en: A yearly cull keeps the number of animals under control.
ex.zh: 每年一次的撲殺能把動物數量控制住。

ex.en: He gave the report only a cursory glance.
ex.zh: 他只匆匆瞄了一眼那份報告。

ex.en: A cursory check missed the small error.
ex.zh: 草率的檢查漏掉了那個小錯誤。

ex.en: The museum custodian looks after the old books.
ex.zh: 博物館的保管人負責照管古書。

ex.en: He is the custodian of the family's records.
ex.zh: 他是家族文件的保管人。

ex.en: The school custodian locks the doors at six.
ex.zh: 學校的工友在六點鎖門。

ex.en: Ask the custodian to clean the spill.
ex.zh: 請工友來清理灑出的東西。

ex.en: The baby held a cuddly toy bear while she slept.
ex.zh: 寶寶睡覺時抱著一隻軟綿綿的玩具熊。

ex.en: Our cat is very cuddly and loves to sit on laps.
ex.zh: 我們的貓很愛撒嬌，喜歡坐在大腿上。

ex.en: This apple cultivar is known for its sweet taste.
ex.zh: 這個蘋果栽培品種以甜味聞名。

ex.en: Farmers chose a new cultivar of rice that resists disease.
ex.zh: 農民選了一個抗病的新稻米品種。

ex.en: She ordered a customized phone case with her name on it.
ex.zh: 她訂做了一個印有自己名字的手機殼。

ex.en: The company offers customized training for each team.
ex.zh: 這家公司為每個團隊提供客製化的訓練。

ex.en: The kids made a paper cutout of a snowman.
ex.zh: 孩子們剪出一個雪人的紙樣。

ex.en: There was a cardboard cutout of the actor in the shop window.
ex.zh: 商店櫥窗裡有一個那位演員的真人立牌。

ex.en: Please leave the boxes at the curbside for pickup.
ex.zh: 請把箱子放在路邊等人來收。

ex.en: The car stopped at the curbside in front of the cafe.
ex.zh: 車子停在咖啡館前的路邊。

curt.zh: 簡短而不禮貌的；生硬的

ex.en: He gave a curt answer and walked away.
ex.zh: 他生硬地回了一句就走開了。

ex.en: Her curt reply hurt my feelings.
ex.zh: 她那簡短冷淡的回答傷了我的心。

ex.en: My grandmother puts currants in her sweet bread.
ex.zh: 我奶奶會在甜麵包裡加無籽小葡萄乾。

ex.en: The bakery sells buns filled with currants.
ex.zh: 這家烘焙坊賣包有小葡萄乾的小圓麵包。

ex.en: We picked red currants from the bush in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們從花園的灌木叢摘了紅醋栗。

ex.en: She made a jam from black currants.
ex.zh: 她用黑醋栗做了果醬。

ex.en: She baked a dozen cupcakes for her son's birthday party.
ex.zh: 她為兒子的生日派對烤了十二個杯子蛋糕。

ex.en: I put a cupcake with pink frosting on each plate.
ex.zh: 我在每個盤子上放了一個粉紅糖霜的杯子蛋糕。

ex.en: The school hired a custodial staff to clean the building.
ex.zh: 學校聘請了管理維護人員來清潔大樓。

ex.en: The mother was given custodial care of the child.
ex.zh: 母親取得了孩子的監護照顧權。

ex.en: The country is on the cusp of a major change.
ex.zh: 這個國家正處在重大變革的關頭。

ex.en: The crescent moon has a sharp cusp at each end.
ex.zh: 新月的兩端各有一個尖角。

ex.en: He answered the question curtly and walked away.
ex.zh: 他簡短而冷淡地回答了問題就走開了。

ex.en: "I'm busy," she said curtly.
ex.zh: 「我很忙。」她不客氣地說。

ex.en: Cheese is made from milk curd.
ex.zh: 起司是用牛奶的凝乳做成的。

ex.en: She ate bean curd with rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚餐吃了豆腐配飯。

ex.en: Picasso was one of the artists who helped create cubism.
ex.zh: 畢卡索是協助創立立體派的藝術家之一。

ex.en: Cubism shows objects from several angles at the same time.
ex.zh: 立體派把物體同時從多個角度呈現出來。

ex.en: Curling is a winter sport played on ice with heavy stones.
ex.zh: 冰壺是一種在冰上用重石進行的冬季運動。

ex.en: We watched a curling match on TV last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在電視上看了一場冰壺比賽。

ex.en: She used a curling iron to style her hair.
ex.zh: 她用電捲棒整理髮型。

ex.en: Smoke rose in a curling line from the chimney.
ex.zh: 煙從煙囪中盤旋捲曲地升起。

ex.en: We drove along a curving road through the hills.
ex.zh: 我們沿著穿過山丘的彎曲道路開車。

ex.en: The building has a graceful curving roof.
ex.zh: 那棟建築有優美彎曲的屋頂。

cutthroat.zh: 殘酷無情的；競爭激烈的

ex.en: The fashion industry can be cutthroat.
ex.zh: 時尚產業可能競爭得非常殘酷。

ex.en: They faced cutthroat competition from larger companies.
ex.zh: 他們面臨來自大公司的激烈競爭。

ex.en: She pushed back her cuticles before painting her nails.
ex.zh: 她擦指甲油前先把指緣皮往後推。

ex.en: The cuticle of a leaf protects it from losing water.
ex.zh: 葉子的表皮能防止水分流失。

ex.en: The investigation found no culpability on the driver's part.
ex.zh: 調查發現駕駛並無過失責任。

ex.en: He admitted his culpability and apologized.
ex.zh: 他承認自己有過失並道歉。

ex.en: Guests customarily remove their shoes at the door.
ex.zh: 客人通常會在門口脫鞋。

ex.en: She customarily wakes up before sunrise.
ex.zh: 她習慣在日出前起床。

ex.en: The fox cunningly hid behind the bushes and waited.
ex.zh: 狐狸狡猾地躲在灌木叢後等待。

ex.en: The room was cunningly designed to look much bigger than it is.
ex.zh: 這個房間被巧妙地設計，看起來比實際大很多。

ex.en: The driver was found culpable for the accident.
ex.zh: 那位駕駛被認定對事故有過失。

ex.en: She felt culpable for not telling the truth sooner.
ex.zh: 她覺得自己沒有早點說實話而該受責備。

ex.en: He got a cushy job with good pay and short hours.
ex.zh: 他找到一份薪水好、工時又短的輕鬆工作。

ex.en: They lead a cushy life in a big house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他們在海邊的大房子裡過著安逸的生活。

ex.en: The museum hired a new curatorial team.
ex.zh: 博物館聘請了新的策展團隊。

ex.en: Her curatorial work includes choosing which paintings to display.
ex.zh: 她的策展工作包括挑選要展出的畫作。

ex.en: The pitcher threw a curveball and the batter missed.
ex.zh: 投手投出一顆曲球，打者揮棒落空。

ex.en: It is hard to hit a curveball when you cannot see the spin.
ex.zh: 看不清旋轉時，很難擊中曲球。

ex.en: The sudden schedule change threw us a curveball.
ex.zh: 突然更改的時程給我們出了個意外的難題。

ex.en: Life threw her a curveball when the shop closed.
ex.zh: 店面歇業，讓她的人生遇上了意想不到的考驗。

ex.en: The workers cut down the old tree behind the school.
ex.zh: 工人把學校後面那棵老樹砍倒了。

ex.en: They had to cut down several trees to build the road.
ex.zh: 為了修路，他們得砍倒好幾棵樹。

ex.en: The doctor told him to cut down on salt.
ex.zh: 醫生叫他減少鹽的攝取。

ex.en: We should cut down our spending this month.
ex.zh: 我們這個月應該減少開銷。
